description: This file is a Perl script named 'slugimage.pl' used for manipulating NSLU2 firmware images. It contains functions for reading, parsing, modifying, and writing firmware images, managing partition tables, and handling various firmware components such as RedBoot, Kernel, Ramdisk, and others. The script includes logic for handling binary data, creating and parsing partition entries, and constructing firmware images for embedded devices.

methods.name: padBytes
methods.description: Pads the given data with 0xFF bytes until it reaches the total length specified.

methods.name: paddedSize
methods.description: Calculates the next multiple of block_size greater than or equal to the data length.

methods.name: numBlocks
methods.description: Calculates the number of blocks needed to hold given data length.

methods.name: createPartitionEntry
methods.description: Creates a binary-packed partition entry with name, address, size, and optional skips.

methods.name: parsePartitionEntry
methods.description: Parses a binary partition entry and returns its components or terminates on invalid data.

methods.name: findPartitionTable
methods.description: Finds the partition table within firmware data if present.

methods.name: parsePartitionTable
methods.description: Parses a partition table and returns an array of partition info references.

methods.name: jffs2Block
methods.description: Creates an empty JFFS2 block.

methods.name: writeOut
methods.description: Writes binary data to a specified filename.

methods.name: trailerData
methods.description: Constructs a trailer data structure (not used currently).

methods.name: printRedbootTrailer
methods.description: Prints details from a RedBoot trailer.

methods.name: removeOptionalLoader
methods.description: Removes the optional Loader partition and resets offsets for Kernel and Ramdisk.

methods.name: spliceFirmwarePartitions
methods.description: Populates partition offsets and sizes based on the firmware's partition table.

methods.name: buildPartitionTable
methods.description: Builds the binary partition table from the partition info.

methods.name: writeOutFirmware
methods.description: Constructs and writes the complete firmware image from partition data.

methods.name: checkPartitionTable
methods.description: Sanity-checks the partition table data (mainly for testing).

methods.name: printPartitions
methods.description: Prints a human-readable list of partition information.

methods.name: defaultPartitions
methods.description: Returns the default set of partitions for firmware image configuration.

methods.name: readInFirmware
methods.description: Reads in an entire firmware image file and populates partition data structures.

methods.name: readInFirmwareParts
methods.description: Reads partition data from associated files into memory.

methods.name: writeOutFirmwareParts
methods.description: Writes in-memory partition data back to their respective files.

methods.name: layoutPartitions
methods.description: Calculates the start, size, and offsets for each partition based on constraints.
